newsitem.title: USA: Sierra Pacific electric rate cut approved.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Pacific electric rate cut approved.

text.p: The Nevada Public Service Commission (PSC) on Thursday approved an agreement by Sierra Pacific Power Co to reduce the utility's Nevada electric prices by $7.1 million, freeze some energy prices until the year 2000, and refund $13 million to electric customers.
The approval today by the PSC means the decrease, freeze and refund are effective immediately.
"We've been working hard to streamline our work force, increase operating efficiencies and hold down costs," said Doug Ponn, executive director, government and regulatory affairs for Sierra Pacific.
